title: One consent vote: 41 contracts, $26 million
question: What did the board approve in one consent-calendar vote on 9 June 2026, and who got it?
finding: Item 14 of 9 June 2026 approved 41 contracts over $119,100 worth $25,825,002 in a single consent vote; the item's own total is $26,221,802, $396,800 more than its attachments add up to (exactly the amount of one attachment, Real Options For City Kids SFSD-Vis. Valley MS, which may be counted twice). 30 of them, $20,002,118, are school-site programmes run through the Student and Family Services Division; Bay Area Community Resources alone has 15 worth $11,028,600. 3 are with individual contractors, $1,081,000, two of them in the Superintendent's Office at $425,000 and $450,000.
how: The attachment list of the agenda item (printed to PDF) was read line by line; each line names the contractor, the office and the amount. Amounts are grouped by contractor. "City ledger" is a name match against the City Controller vendor-payment file, all years.
limits: A consent vote is the board's ordinary method for routine items; the papers were posted in advance. Many after-school contracts are the district's share of programmes the City also funds, so one organization appearing on both ledgers is expected. Individual contractors are a permitted form of professional-services contract under Government Code section 53060, which the contracts cite. Only 7 of the contract PDFs are on disk.
